about: Golf-sense questions for CoachHelm chat. Each question says what a correct answer must state (facts), must not state (forbid), and which reads it should use (readers; an empty list means it can be answered from the prompt or the reference). Placeholders in braces are filled from the staging roster by the harness: {player}, {player2} (two active players with rounds), {new_player} (a player with fewer than three shot-tracked rounds), {teammate} (for a player's turn: any other player on the team). A fact is a phrase the answer must match; these questions test meaning and direction, so no figure is expected here (the data questions in scripts/coachhelm/ask-eval.mjs check figures).
